score_definition.viability: confirmed = 90% interval of the unsafe rate inside the budget and coverage at or above the floor; provisional = point estimate inside the budget only; not viable = outside the budget or below the floor. Tiers rank in that order.
score_definition.coverage: share of holdout cases the model alone would clear at the STP threshold
score_definition.calibration: 1 - ECE / max acceptable ECE, floored at 0
score_definition.repeats: with more than one seed the score is the mean over seeds and a candidate that left the budget on any seed is held at provisional
score_definition.ties: a viable candidate whose unsafe and coverage intervals both overlap the leader's is marked tied; the order among tied candidates is not a finding
